membership: eligible pool = provenance-establishable AND eligible; unknown provenance not eligible; unscored open candidates recorded, never pooled

freshness.sensitivityRole: secondary sensitivity estimand, always reported, never a fallback

selection.anchor: F(L) = first valid complete eligible non-left-censored window; P(W) = {L : F(L) = W}; all P(W) retired after W; no refill
selection.leftCensoring: open in the run's first window, or opened before the run's first receipt market time
selection.armA: confirmation receive sequence ascending; tie opportunityId ascending
selection.armB: engine earlyQualityRank ascending; missing rank after every rank; tie opportunityId ascending; OI evidence must be loss-free

outcome.anchor: T0 = rank completion wall timestamp; P0 = clause-3 provenance price
outcome.priceRepresentation: integer micro-dollars; exact i128 comparison price*10000 >= anchor*(10000+targetBasisPoints)
outcome.primaryScope: T0 >= regular open and T0 + horizon < regular close, NYSE calendar incl. early closes
outcome.source: alpaca-v2-stocks-trades-v1: post-session SIP historical trades per OUTCOME-SOURCE-CONTRACT.md, archived as outcome-evidence-v1, fetched only after campaign closure and explicit authorization

status.interruptionRule: HALT/PAUSE/NON_TRADABLE or unclassified status overlapping (T0, T0+300s]: success only if the target was reached before the interruption began, else censored; RESUME ends it; INFORMATIONAL changes nothing
status.completeness: status knowledge only where the run status tap is loss-free and full-market coverage spans the horizon; otherwise censored

censoring.rule: any censored selected candidate in a window excludes that window from both arms

inference.statistic: D_s = (hits_A - hits_B) / total_k over discriminating, uncensored, in-scope windows
inference.descriptive: mean and t interval, df = S - 1, DESCRIPTIVE only

export.deletion: manual, separately authorized; eligibility computed only

campaign.rule: designate <= calendarCapSessions; close when qualifyingSessions qualify on measurement evidence alone; MEASUREMENT_INSUFFICIENT if the cap is reached first; outcomes locked until closed AND explicitly authorized
